# Design option

- ID and summary:
- User problem and acceptance criteria:
- Architecture evidence and affected boundaries:
- Comparable products, authoritative links, and transferable lessons:
- Alternatives, trade-offs, estimated effort, and unresolved questions:

## Implementation plan
Components/files, dependencies, compatibility, sequencing, migrations, and flags.

## Testing plan
Requirement-to-test mapping, unit/functional/fault scenarios, coverage thresholds,
performance baseline/candidate workloads where relevant, and exit criteria.

## Rollback plan
Trigger thresholds, code/config/data reversibility, exact approved recovery
procedure, irreversible effects, and rollback rehearsal.

## Debugging plan
Logs/metrics/traces/dumps, correlation IDs, collection/analysis procedures,
redaction/retention/overhead constraints, and a diagnosability test.

## Documentation plan
Executive, developer, and user documents; troubleshooting and ownership.

## Rollout plan
Environments, approval owners, canary stages, exposure limits, health criteria,
abort conditions, and supported-release dependency inventory.
